result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear data/rendering bug ('€NaN delivery') and a few minor cosmetic concerns related to truncated/clipped elements at screen edges.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card in the 'Fastest near you' section displays '€NaN delivery', indicating a failed number formatting or missing delivery fee value in the data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the data source or add a fallback: validate the delivery fee before formatting and show 'Free delivery' or hide the fee line when the value is missing/invalid.

issues.description: The last category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge with no visible label, which may look broken if horizontal scrolling isn't obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade/gradient at the edge of the chip carousel or adjust padding so partially visible chips clearly signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the screen edge without an ellipsis, appearing abruptly truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis truncation within the card bounds, or ensure the card carousel visually indicates more content off-screen.
